title: Endpoint
description: A single network endpoint representing a pod IP address, its readiness conditions, and optional topology information for advanced routing.

addresses.description: Canonical IP addresses of this endpoint, in IPv4 or IPv6 format. Between 1 and 100 addresses per endpoint.

hostname.description: DNS hostname for this endpoint. Used by headless services to generate per-pod DNS records.

nodeName.description: Node on which this endpoint resides.

zone.description: Availability zone where the endpoint is located, used for topology-aware routing.

targetRef.description: Reference to the Kubernetes object backing this endpoint.
